title: Required input missing → rejected
rule: specs/aip-58.mdx §3 Outcome rule — “Invalid or missing required input”

expected.runCreateOutcome: either rejects the call outright, or persists a terminal run — both conforming
notes: No step.started event MUST appear anywhere in the log — the host MUST reject before dispatching the first step.
run.started MUST NOT appear — the run never entered the running state.
